categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Bohui Science & Technology Co., Ltd focuses on the audiovisual big data sector, providing intelligent audiovisual information technology products and services across three main areas: media security, smart education, and intelligent display control. The company offers comprehensive solutions including media content safety monitoring and regulation, smart classroom and teaching solutions, and large-screen display and seat collaboration systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include audiovisual big data collection, analysis, and visualization, with proprietary software and hardware products. Key technological capabilities encompass edge data collection, intelligent content analysis using AI and multimodal recognition, high-definition video encoding and transmission, audiovisual data security intelligence, and digital twin technology. The company emphasizes AI integration, including large model algorithms for content analysis and AI-generated content recognition, with a focus on domestic technology localization and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include television stations, broadcasting and telecommunications operators, government media regulatory agencies, educational institutions (notably universities and vocational colleges), and government enterprises such as civil defense units. The company serves media regulators, broadcasters, IPTV platforms, telecom operators, and educational entities across China, providing tailored audiovisual data solutions for media security, education digitalization, and command and control display systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant business presence in major regions including North China, Central China, South China, East China, Northeast China, Northwest China, and Southwest China. Its products and services cover national-level clients such as the National Radio and Television Administration and provincial broadcasting bureaus across 28 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Bohui operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the audiovisual information technology supply chain. It develops proprietary software and hardware products and provides integrated solutions and services directly to end customers such as broadcasters, regulators, educational institutions, and government entities. The company outsources hardware manufacturing and focuses on software development, system integration, and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in AI technologies, including large model algorithms, multimodal content analysis, AI-generated content recognition, and digital twin technologies. It aims to deepen AI integration in media security, smart education, and intelligent display control. The strategic direction includes expanding AI capabilities, promoting domestic technology substitution, enhancing product innovation in 5G, cloud computing, big data analytics, and blockchain, and exploring new markets such as low-altitude economy and cultural tourism.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary software and hardware solutions, including audiovisual monitoring systems, smart classroom products, and display control systems. The company also earns income from technical services such as system integration, technical support, and customized solution development. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with end customers and through agents or system integrators, often involving bidding and negotiated contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Beijing Bohui is positioned as a leading domestic provider of audiovisual information technology solutions with strong brand recognition and extensive customer coverage in media, education, and government sectors. It competes with other technology firms in the audiovisual big data and AI application space, leveraging its deep industry experience, proprietary technologies, and comprehensive service capabilities to maintain a competitive edge. The company is recognized as an innovation partner in Beijing’s general AI industry and actively participates in industry standard setting.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 172.8 million, a 9.9% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.47 million, showing a reduction in losses compared to prior years. Total assets stood at RMB 726 million, with shareholders’ equity of RMB 615 million. The company invests heavily in R&D, accounting for over 31% of revenue, and maintains a stable but currently loss-making financial profile with ongoing efforts to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its deep technical expertise and proprietary AI-driven audiovisual big data technologies to deliver high-accuracy, high-reliability, and secure audiovisual content monitoring and analysis solutions. Its products feature advanced multimodal AI recognition, real-time content safety monitoring, and intelligent command and control display capabilities. The integration of AI with domain-specific applications in media security, education, and intelligent display control differentiates its offerings, supported by strong customer service and extensive industry experience.
